reader_summary.overview: Michael Milken is a legendary financier and philanthropist. Mike is best known for his role in creating the high yield bond market in the 1970s and 1980s at Drexel Burnham Lambert, his guilty plea. Under Mike's leadership, upstart Drexel became the most successful securities firm on Wall Street.

key_points.text: Mike is best known for his role in creating the high yield bond market in the 1970s and 1980s at Drexel Burnham Lambert.
Under Mike's leadership, upstart Drexel became the most successful securities firm on Wall Street.
Approximately seventy investment firms are headed by leaders who worked for Mike, including founders and leaders of Apollo, Ares, Blackstone, Canyon, Cerberus, Crescent, GoldenTree.
